shortDescription: BPSC Exam Calendar 2026 released with tentative dates for CCE, Stenographer and other recruitments. Download PDF from bpsc.bihar.gov.in.
content:
Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has published the Exam Calendar 2026 (dates are tentative) on its official website.

The calendar covers three-phase exams (PT + Mains + Interview), two-phase and single-phase examinations including Combined Competitive Examinations (70th/71st/72nd cycles as scheduled), Stenographer and other departmental posts.

How to use

  • Download the official PDF from bpsc.bihar.gov.in
  • All dates are tentative and may be revised
  • 72nd CCE Prelims was earlier listed around July 2026 (check latest notice for postponements)
